entities.summary: Usfurid Bedouin, a notable figure in the history of Bahrain, associated with Uyunid and Usfurid Dynasties (1253–1521). Preceded by Usfurid and Jabrid Dynasties and Uyunid. Their legacy influenced Portuguese conquer Bahrain and build fortifications at Qal'at al-Bahrain.
